pundit.name: Clint Dempsey
pundit.take:
Gunner's more committed to DR Congo than knowing how to close out a game with France.

Both France and Spain have been puttin’ in work, but Gunner, or "Bubba G," is still out here draftin' DR Congo like he's got insider info from his barber, while Devin, "Ghost Pepper," picked Spain with hopes of set pieces hotter than his taco order. You gotta back yourself when your teams are clashin’, but Gunner's roster is all style, no upset points, like a slick haircut with no fade. I'm callin' it now: Ghost Pepper's spicy lineup will outshine Bubba G's overhyped French flair. Get ready to watch this one unfold in Arlington, but don't be surprised when Spain serves a sizzling plate of disappointment to Bubba's barbecue dreams.

pundit_takes.headline: Gunner's France set to crush Devin's Spain in Texas showdown
pundit_takes.subtitle: 'Ghost Pepper' may need to turn down the heat today.
